ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a "MARINE FOOD WEB" marine food web diagram. In the middle of the image there is a node labeled "Horseshoe Crab and Eggs", and in the lower right there is a bird labeled "Grackle". It can be seen that there is an arrow directly pointing from the "Horseshoe Crab and Eggs" node to "Grackle". Reasoning: In a food web, organisms directly connected by arrows indicate the most direct feeding or influence relationship. Because grackle is directly connected with "Horseshoe Crab and Eggs", if grackles change, the most directly affected are horseshoe crabs / horseshoe crab eggs.
